CallStatement.description:
Call a function defined in the enclosing wfspec's `functions`.

A `call` is executed as an inline child workflow: the referenced function runs in a

ChildMode.description:
Define execution mode for child workflow.

- INLINE: Execute child workflow inline within the same workflow context (default).
- SYNC: Execute child workflow as an independent workflow, wait for completion before continuing.
- ASYNC: Execute child workflow as an independent workflow asynchronously, not wait for completion.
    Child will terminate when parent terminates.
- DETACHED: Execute child workflow as an independent workflow detached from parent. No wait for completion.
    Child will continue running even if parent terminates.
ChildMode.title: ChildMode

ConditionNot.description:
Logical NOT condition: negates the sub-condition.

ConditionNot.title: ConditionNot

ConditionOr.description:
Logical OR condition: evaluates to True if any sub-condition is True.
Supports short-circuit evaluation.

Unified timeout and retry configuration for activities and workflows.

A single object carrying both execution timeouts and retry behavior. Used by
activities (``ActivityRecord``) and workflows (``WorkflowSpec`` /
``WorkflowExecuteOptions``). Only the Temporalio runtime honors these settings;
the in-memory runtime ignores them.

All fields are optional so a policy can be layered over another (see
``merge_over``): a per-call policy overrides a provider/spec default field-by-field.

StateCheckpointPolicy.description:
Let the runtime checkpoint (continue-as-new) while the machine sits in this state, and
resume in this same state afterwards.

The runtime fires the checkpoint at a point where the machine is settled — on_enter has
finished and no transition is in flight — so on resume it can re-enter the state directly,
skipping on_enter and re-arming timers. This replaces the manual pattern of a sentinel
variable, guard conditions, a synthetic event and an extra transition edge.

Requires the wfspec body to be a single state_machine statement, which is what makes the
resume point unambiguous.
StateCheckpointPolicy.title: StateCheckpointPolicy

StateMachineState.title: StateMachineState

StateMachineTimer.description:
Define a named timer for a state machine state.

When the timer fires, it emits a 'sys.timer.<name>' event that can be used as a trigger
for state transitions. If retries are exhausted with no matching transition, a
'sys.timer.<name>.final' event is emitted.
StateMachineTimer.title: StateMachineTimer

StateMachineTransition.description:
Define a transition between states in state machine.

from_state accepts a single state name, a list of state names, or null.
- str: transition applies from that specific state
- list[str]: transition applies from each listed state (expanded by the builder)
- None or []: wildcard — transition matches from any state

If to_state is omitted (None), this is an internal transition:
- The action executes but the state does not change
- No exit/enter callbacks are invoked
- The machine remains in from_state
StateMachineTransition.title: StateMachineTransition

StateMachineTransitionTrigger.description:
Define a trigger for state machine transition.

For event-driven transitions, specify event_type.
For automatic transitions, omit event_type (or set to null).
StateMachineTransitionTrigger.title: StateMachineTransitionTrigger

WaitForRecord.description:

- The timeout_sec expires (returns None)
WaitForRecord.title: WaitForRecord

- user_org_name:mocoland technology
- group:user:moco_admins
- *

Examples of non-user based grant patterns:
- oauth_client_id:myapp
- web_origin:https://example.com
- target_web_origin:https://*.prod.bloomberg.com
- wfspec_name:intenal.example_workflow
- parent_wfspec_name:ai.*
- wfspec_tag:category:ai
- tier: beta
- debug_mode:true
- env:DEVCONTAINER:true
- group:moco_services
- group:http-allow-list.prod
- *
- parent_wfspec_name:ai.*
Grant.title: Grant

Input for apikey.lookup activity.

Carries the non-secret key_prefix, never the secret. That is the whole point: a

the plaintext never becomes activity input, worker log output or Temporal history.

activity_input.builtin.deploy.query.get_.description:
Input for query.get_targeted_wfspec_version activity.

Version filtering: Use version_filter string to filter versions.
Format: "major.minor.patch" where '*' is wildcard for any value.

Examples:
    - No filter (highest version): version_filter=None or "*.*.*"
    - Match 1.1.* : version_filter="1.1.*"
    - Match 2.*.* : version_filter="2.*.*"
    - Exact 1.2.3 : version_filter="1.2.3"

version_filter.description: Version filter pattern (e.g., '1.1.*', '2.*.*', '1.2.3'). None = any version.

ClaudeCapabilities.description:
Everything the agent is permitted to do.

Grouped into one model deliberately: ``builtin_tools``, ``moco_tools`` and ``mcp_servers`` are
three faces of a single privilege grant, and reviewing them together is the only way to see
what an agent can actually reach. All three default to empty — an agent with no capabilities
can only produce text.
ClaudeCapabilities.title: ClaudeCapabilities

attachments must be provided as base64-encoded data.
EmailAttachment.title: EmailAttachment

activity_input.email.send.description:
Input model for email.send activity.

Supports SMTP configuration, authentication, TLS/SSL, attachments,
and various email features like CC, BCC, reply-to, and custom headers.

Example:
    >>> input_data = SendEmailInput(
    ...     smtp_host="smtp.gmail.com",
    ...     smtp_port=587,
    ...     username="user@example.com",
    ...     password="secret",
    ...     from_address="sender@example.com",
    ...     to_addresses=["recipient@example.com"],
    ...     subject="Test Email",
    ...     body_text="This is a test email."
    ... )
activity_input.email.send.title: SendEmailInput

activity_input.http.request.description:
Input model for HTTP request activity.

This model defines the configuration for making HTTP requests through
the http.request activity. It supports various HTTP methods, authentication,
proxies, and response handling options.

Example:
    >>> input_data = HttpRequestInput(
    ...     method="POST",
    ...     url="https://api.example.com/data",
    ...     json={"key": "value"},
    ...     headers={"X-Custom-Header": "custom-value"}
    ... )
activity_input.http.request.title: HttpRequestInput

KubeConnection.description:
How to reach a cluster.

Credentials are never inline: ``token_secret_key`` and the client-cert keys name a stored
secret, resolved through the shared SecretResolver at execution time. ``ca_cert`` is the one
exception and takes inline PEM, because a CA certificate is public material.
KubeConnection.title: KubeConnection
